messages:
jess: heads up — multiple customers reporting duplicate SSE events when clients resume after ~30s idle. noticed billing/token spike and confused app state.
ryan: which tenants/regions? any shared routing path?
jess: two tenants in us-west, one in eu-central. all on the resume path through the opaque-proxy layer. rate is low but billing doubled on resumed sessions.
priya: saw something in telemetry stacks — resume path returns 200 but our lease validation sometimes returns MISS at router. attaching quick logs.
priya: ```
[proxy] resume req id=abc123 lease=42 -> 200 resume_id=xyz
[router] lease_lookup id=42 -> MISS
[kvcache] prefix_lookup stream=abc123 -> NOT_FOUND
[backend] stream_replay last_event_id=E9 -> SENT
```
sam: if lease_lookup misses the router forwards to a backend that replays last events. clients reconnect and get the same events again -> duplicates.
infra-bot: alert: quota_spike tenant=t-42 metric=tokens_billed spike=+120% at 2026-03-20T14:02Z
priya: console UX note — current telemetry just tags "stream-resume" but doesn't break down resume outcome (lease-validated vs lease-miss vs replay-duplicate). Would be good to add resume_outcome tag.
ryan: routing policy question: do we make resume a blocking lease-validate RPC (adds ~10-30ms p99) or keep optimistic forward with later de-dupe?
jess: duplicates are customer-visible and cause billing/user confusion. leaning toward blocking validation for resume on canary so we avoid replay.
sam: implementation idea: router consults lease-service TTL header. If unknown -> synchronous validate_lease RPC (timeout 50ms). fallback path: forward if validate times out. Pseudo-config: 
```
resume_policy:
  validate_lease: true
  validate_timeout_ms: 50
  fallback: forward
```
priya: console changes: I'll add fields: resume_validate_ms, resume_path=(validate|fallback|forward), duplicate_detected=(true|false). will wire to rollout dashboard.
ryan: rollout plan suggestion: canary 5% us-west for 24h, monitor: resume_error_rate, duplicate_count, p99_resume_latency. abort if duplicate_count not falling or p99_latency > +15ms.
jess: who runs the canary? eng-platform + eng-runtime. I'll open the PR and include the config flag behind `resume_validate` feature flag. Also need billing safety: ops may need to refund duplicate-charged tokens if we find an earlier replay window.
sam: short-term mitigation: add server-side de-dup by tracking last-event-id per stream for 60s to drop obvious replays. cheap and helps during rollout.
console-team: we'll add dashboard tile and alert: duplicate_rate > 0.1% sustained for 10m -> page oncall. Also add a histogram of resume_validate_ms.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: 2026-03-21T22:00Z canary 5% us-west. logs will include tag `resume_validate_trace`.
ryan: thx. jess please add a mini runbook for "Resume duplication" with rollback flag and hunt queries (kvcache misses, lease_lookup misses, resume_id replay).
jess: on it — will post PR + runbook link here when ready.
